says: The codex exec adapter reads a turn.completed usage as that turn's whole tokens (whole: true), but on a resumed thread Codex CLI 0.167.0 reports the thread's running total, so every resumed turn counts the earlier turns again.
proof: One real codex exec turn (gpt-6-astra, medium) reported input 103785, cached 89728, output 1012. A resume of that thread asked only for one line and a JSON object, ran 6 seconds with 0 tool calls, and reported input 131864, cached 117376, output 1062: 50 more output tokens than the first turn, not a new turn's own count.
cost: A field row or a dollar total for any resumed Codex turn is too high by every turn before it on the thread, and grows with each round on the same session.
